title: The 5 Best String Trimmers for Edging
h1: The 5 Best String Trimmers for Edging
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for string trimmers for edging, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers for edging using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1521S 15-Inch String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch cutting swath with POWERLOAD auto-feed line, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 2.5Ah included, Carbon fiber split shaft.
strengths: Pivoting head locks cleanly into edging position without extra tools
POWERLOAD auto-feed threads new line in seconds, useful after a long edging session wears the line down
56V battery has enough torque to run the line against curb edges without bogging
Carbon fiber shaft keeps the tool light for one-handed edging control
limitations: 56V battery and charger add cost versus 40V competitors
Proprietary EGO battery doesn't cross over to other brands
No built-in guide wheel, so depth control is by feel
features: 15-inch cutting swath with POWERLOAD auto-feed line

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare battery system, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Pivoting head with adjustable angle.
strengths: Under 5 pounds makes it easy to hold at the edging angle for long stretches
Two included batteries mean a full lot can be edged and trimmed on one charge cycle
Dual-exit head keeps line closer to hardscape without scalping the lawn
limitations: 13-inch swath means more passes on a wide driveway
2.0Ah batteries run down faster on dense edging line-to-concrete contact
Pivot angle has fewer fixed detents than the EGO's mechanism
features: 40V PowerShare battery system, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Pivoting head.
strengths: Lowest price of the group while still including a pivoting head
Variable speed trigger helps conserve battery during precision edging
3-year warranty covers longer than most trimmers at this price
limitations: 12-inch swath is the narrowest here, meaning more time on longer edges
2.0Ah battery has the shortest runtime in this list
Pivot mechanism feels less solid than EGO or Worx

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head.
strengths: 17-inch swath covers a long driveway edge in fewer passes than any battery model here
No battery to manage on properties with hundreds of feet of edging
Straight shaft gives more reach along raised beds and retaining walls
limitations: No dedicated pivoting edge guide, angle is held manually
Heavier and louder than the cordless options
Requires mixed fuel and periodic carburetor maintenance
features: Straight shaft with Tap 'n Go head

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
